# Westlaw State Government Legal Resources

> A comprehensive Thomson Reuters legal database providing free access to state court rules, case law, statutes, attorney general opinions, and regulatory materials across all U.S. states.

Westlaw's government portal aggregates official state legal resources including court decisions, legislative materials, administrative regulations, and judicial opinions. The platform serves legal professionals, government agencies, and the public with searchable access to primary legal authorities from all 50 states.

## Key Topics

- Court Rules
- Case Law
- State Statutes
- Attorney General Opinions
- Court Procedures
- Legal Research
- Jury Instructions
- Administrative Regulations
- Official Reports
- Session Laws
- Thomson Reuters Westlaw
- Free Legal Access
- State Government
- Appellate Courts
- Legal Documents

## Portal & Navigation

- [State Government Sites](https://govt.westlaw.com/Home/Index.html): Homepage for Westlaw state government legal resources and court rules database
- [State Government Sites Directory](https://govt.westlaw.com/SiteList): Directory of state government legal resources across Alaska, Arizona, Arkansas, California and more

## Case Law & Court Decisions

- [Alaska Case Law Service](https://govt.westlaw.com/akcases/Index): Alaska Supreme Court and Appeals Court case law search database
- [California Public Law Library Briefs Service](https://govt.westlaw.com/cabriefs/Index): California Supreme Court and Appeals Court briefs and legal documents
- [Michigan Official Reports](https://govt.westlaw.com/miofficial/Index): Michigan court reports including Supreme Court and Appeals decisions
- [New York Official Reports Service](https://govt.westlaw.com/nyofficial/Index): New York Court of Appeals and Appellate Division official reports

## Court Rules & Procedures

- [Arizona Court Rules](https://govt.westlaw.com/azrules/Index): Arizona court rules including civil, criminal, evidence and appellate procedures
- [Kentucky Court Rules](https://govt.westlaw.com/kyrules/Index): Kentucky court rules for civil, criminal, appellate and family courts
- [Maryland Code and Court Rules](https://govt.westlaw.com/mdc/Index): Maryland state legislation and court rules reference database

## Statutes & Legislative Materials

- [Official Oklahoma Session Laws](https://govt.westlaw.com/okleg/Index): Oklahoma official session laws and legislative database
- [Official Oklahoma Statutes (Unannotated)](https://govt.westlaw.com/okjc/Index): Oklahoma unannotated statutes and statute browser database
- [Oklahoma Historical Session Laws](https://govt.westlaw.com/okhl/Index): Oklahoma historical session laws and legislative search database
- [Oklahoma Historical Statutes (Unannotated)](https://govt.westlaw.com/okhs/Index): Oklahoma historical unannotated statutes and legal research database

## Regulations & Administrative Law

- [California Code of Regulations](https://govt.westlaw.com/calregs/Index): California regulatory index and administrative law codes
- [Arkansas Regulations](https://govt.westlaw.com/arreg/Index): Arkansas administrative code and regulations from state agencies
- [New York State Register](https://govt.westlaw.com/nyreg/Index): New York State Register with regulations and government notices

## Attorney General Opinions

- [Iowa Department of Justice Attorney General Opinions](https://govt.westlaw.com/iaag/Index): Iowa Attorney General opinions and legal analysis database
- [Mississippi Attorney General Opinions](https://govt.westlaw.com/msag/Index): Mississippi Attorney General searchable opinions database

## Optional

- [Arkansas Model Jury Instructions - Civil](https://govt.westlaw.com/armji/Index): Arkansas civil jury instructions for negligence, tort law and court procedures
- [Clarence Darrow Cases](https://govt.westlaw.com/clar/Index): Searchable archive of Clarence Darrow historical cases
